children: Director Steven Scheid reported selling 15,611 NMI Holdings common shares through the Scheid Family Trust, of which he and his wife are co-trustees and beneficiaries, at a weighted average price of $38.521 per share on November 20, 2026. The reported total sale amount was $601,351. After the transaction, Scheid directly held 4,512 unvested restricted stock units and indirectly held 63,622 common shares through the Scheid Family Trust.
